import pytest
import sqlglot
from sqlglot.errors import ParseError

def test_mysql_create_table_auto_increment_key_parse_error():
    sql = """CREATE TABLE t1(id INT KEY AUTO_INCREMENT);"""
    with pytest.raises(ParseError) as excinfo:
        sqlglot.parse_one(sql, read="mysql")
    assert "Expecting" in str(excinfo.value)
    assert "Line 1, Col: 42" in str(excinfo.value)
